source: Prawo o ruchu drogowym (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1251) art. 20 ust. 1 (obszar zabudowany 50 km/h), ust. 2 (strefa zamieszkania 20 km/h), ust. 3 pkt 1 (autostrada 140; droga ekspresowa dwujezdniowa 120; droga ekspresowa jednojezdniowa oraz droga dwujezdniowa co najmniej o dwoch pasach dla kazdego kierunku 100; pozostale drogi 90)

notes.expressway: an expressway is a way with motorroad=yes or a highway=motorway whose refs are all S-numbers (Polish expressways are commonly mapped as highway=motorway)
notes.built_up: the built-up area is defined by the D-42/D-43 signs; the pack knows it from way tags (PL:urban, zone:traffic ...) or infers it from landuse polygons, and marks which
notes.link: an untagged motorway/expressway slip road gets no implicit limit (null)
